description: Update the single authorized onboarding workflow so remote onboarding can be triggered by a no-op canonical FilePatcher request and can publish a durable frame-conn/onboarding commit status that points to the receipt-bearing run.
acceptance_criteria: A patch id prefixed toolchain-onboarding-remote-trigger- can activate onboarding without a local checkout or source mutation.
Successful onboarding publishes frame-conn/onboarding=success on the triggering commit only after the COMPLETE drill and receipt upload succeed.
Failed onboarding or failed receipt publication publishes frame-conn/onboarding=failure and the workflow fails closed.
The existing trigger-file and workflow_dispatch entrypoints remain supported.
raw_operations_reason: This request intentionally targets exactly one protected workflow already explicitly authorized by the user; Toolchain Orchestrator must surface the protected-path CAPABILITY_GAP so the Infrastructure Publisher exception remains the sole publication boundary.
